subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Robust Control: Handling Uncertainty
description: Learn Robust Control: Handling Uncertainty in one minute.

hook.text: No model is perfect. Robust control guarantees performance even when the model is somewhat wrong.

buildup.text: H-infinity (H∞) control minimizes the worst-case gain from disturbance to error. It designs for the worst.

discovery.text: The designer specifies uncertainty bounds. The controller guarantees stability across all possible plants within.

twist.text: Robustness costs performance — a controller safe for all conditions is never optimal for any single one.

climax.text: Hard disk read heads, jet engine fuel controls, and automotive stability systems use robust designs.

punchline.text: Plan for the worst, perform through anything — robust control endures.

quiz.question: What trade-off does robust control introduce?
options: Higher energy consumption for faster response
Guaranteed stability across uncertainties at the cost of optimal performance for any single condition
Simpler design at the cost of more sensors
